automated_tests.limits: Input scenarios are exercised inside named tests, not counted as additional independent tests. Provider contracts are mocked.

golden_live_run.scope: One live response per researched scenario, followed by assistant review. Transport completion is separate from semantic accuracy. Subsequent pediatric safety routing was rechecked on the final release.

model_quality_limits: Generated answers can omit relevant details or make overbroad claims. No full semantic or clinical accuracy certification is claimed.
diagnostics: Raw runs and detailed review notes are maintained outside the repository.
